title: 第7章 悟性第8章 打听第9章 境界
content_zh:
众人脸上的表情都古怪起来，包括于峰。
他似是没想到陈冲操心的是这个，窒了半晌，才道
“管饱。你也一样。”
陈冲便点头道
“我学。”
“好。”
于峰深深看了他一眼，然后开始给五人讲解起要点。
“记住，每次都要用腹式呼吸，确保气息到达身体深处……”
“三短三长三短后五长四短，但不是说中间有间隔，要视作一个整体。看……”
“胸腹要放松，背不要死板。这是呼吸法，不是扎马，你平时都是摆好造型才呼吸的吗？”
“蠢货。”
四人都是头一回接触呼吸法，上手各有些困难。但过不多时，几人进度就分出些差别来。
最快的是陈冲，他的理解力很好，基本上听一遍就会；到自己模仿时上手也快，只要于峰纠正一遍就不会再出问题。
然后是李晓光，他是备考武院的学生，这方面的基础扎实，上手不算慢。
王力就吃力许多，皱着眉头面红耳赤，喘得像牛却也找不到诀窍，挨骂最多的便是他。
至于刘河涛，则根本听不大懂的样子，更不用说练习。他一脸茫然，于峰却反而也没骂他。
这套呼吸法很长，一次完整的流程要五到十分钟，中间还不能间断。
但陈冲很快发现了规律。
“每次节奏变幻都是以九次呼吸或者九的倍数作为节点，前后各有对照的地方，如同歌曲的主歌副歌……”
于是不到一个小时，他就将全部流程都记了下来，默默的尝试着完整练习。

他的进度极快，虽然没有吱声，但一直默默关注的于峰很快发现了。
于峰一挥手，让几人都停下，然后指着陈冲
“你试一下。”
陈冲闪过几个念头，最后并没有藏拙的打算。他按照刚刚学会的法门，略带生涩、节奏略迟缓的演练了一遍，细蛇般的白气在他的脸侧缭绕。
李晓光几人一开始还不知道于教练是什么意思，直到陈冲渐入佳境，白气呈现出某种韵律，才不约而同的露出惊讶的神色来。
快十分钟过去，陈冲结束了，另外三人的惊讶都变成了震惊。
最快的李晓光也才学了一半不到，陈冲竟然已经能完整的做出来了？
刘河涛一脸佩服，讷讷道
“好厉害。”
李晓光的表情也差不多，不过比刘河涛多了一点斗志；王力切了一声，不是太服气。
但他们现在明白于峰为什么把陈冲也叫过来了。
于峰的眼神深处多了一丝波动，但很快平息。他点点头
“有什么感觉？”
陈冲凝眉，缓缓道
“感觉……血流得很快，像刚刚跑完一百米，但比那要累，累得多。”
于峰盯着他
“还有呢？”
陈冲身上已经见汗，他继续回忆，片刻后迟疑道
“我隐约感觉，呼进呼出的气息，还有血液似乎都在往身体里渗透。”
他旋即又摇头，血液要是往身体里渗，那麻烦就大了。

于峰缓缓点头，眼神的波动比刚刚还大。
悟性么……
他喉咙滚了一下，没人听清他的声音。
过了会儿，于峰打断了已经热情的向陈冲请教起来的李晓光几人，道
“等你们掌握呼吸法，带动起气息和血液，就可以强化自己的身体素质。往身体里渗透，这是关键，是错觉但也不是，现在说太多你们也不懂。
content_en:
The expressions on everyone's faces became strange, including Yu Feng.
He didn't seem to expect that Chen Chong was worried about this. After being suffocated for a long time, he said
"Just take care of yourself. So do you."
Chen Chong nodded and said
"I'll learn."
"Okay."
Yu Feng took a deep look at him, and then began to explain the key points to the five people.
"Remember, breathe abdominally every time to ensure that the breath reaches deep inside the body..."
"Three short, three long, three short, five long and four short, but it does not mean that there are gaps in the middle. It should be regarded as a whole. Look..."
"The chest and abdomen should be relaxed, and the back should not be rigid. This is a breathing method, not a zama. Do you usually breathe after posing?"
"Idiot."
It was the first time for all four of them to come into contact with the breathing method, and each had some difficulty getting started. But after a while, some differences became apparent in the progress of several people.
The fastest is Chen Chong. His understanding is very good and he can basically understand it after listening to it once. He also gets started quickly when imitating it himself. As long as Yu Feng corrects it once, there will be no problems again.
Then there is Li Xiaoguang. He is a student preparing for the martial arts academy. He has a solid foundation in this area and is not slow to get started.
Wang Li struggled a lot, frowning and blushing, panting like an ox but couldn't find the trick. He was the one who got scolded the most.
As for Liu Hetao, he didn't seem to understand much at all, let alone practice. He looked confused, but Yu Feng didn't scold him.
This breathing method is very long. A complete process takes five to ten minutes, and there should be no interruption in between.
But Chen Chong soon discovered the pattern.
"Each rhythm change is based on nine breaths or multiples of nine as a node, with contrasting points before and after, just like the verse and chorus of a song..."
So in less than an hour, he memorized the entire process and silently tried to practice it completely.
His progress was extremely fast. Although he made no sound, Yu Feng, who had been paying attention silently, soon discovered it.
Yu Feng waved his hand to stop everyone, and then pointed at Chen Chong
"You try it."
Chen Chong had a few thoughts, but in the end he had no intention of hiding his clumsiness. He practiced the technique according to the method he had just learned, with a slightly jerky and slow rhythm. White air like a thin snake lingered on the side of his face.
Li Xiaoguang and others didn't know what Coach Yu meant at first. It wasn't until Chen Chong got better and the white energy showed a certain rhythm that they all showed surprise.
Nearly ten minutes passed and Chen Chong finished. The surprise of the other three people turned into shock.
The fastest Li Xiaoguang has only learned less than half of it, but Chen Chong can actually complete it completely?
Liu Hetao said with admiration on his face.
"It's amazing."
Li Xiaoguang's expression was similar, but he had a little more fighting spirit than Liu Hetao; Wang Li made a sound, not too convinced.
But now they understood why Yu Feng called Chen Chong over.
There was a trace of fluctuation in Yu Feng's eyes, but it quickly subsided. he nodded
"How do you feel?"
Chen Chong frowned and said slowly
"It feels like... the blood is flowing very fast, like I just ran a hundred meters, but it's much more tiring than that."
Yu Feng stared at him
"What else?"
Chen Chong was already sweating. He continued to recall and hesitated for a moment.
"I vaguely felt that the breath I was breathing in and out, and the blood seemed to be seeping into my body."
He immediately shook his head again. If blood seeped into his body, he would be in big trouble.
Yu Feng nodded slowly, his eyes fluctuating even more than before.
Comprehension...
His throat rolled, and no one heard him clearly.
After a while, Yu Feng interrupted Li Xiaoguang and others who were already enthusiastically asking Chen Chong for advice, and said
"When you master the breathing method and activate the breath and blood, you can strengthen your physical fitness. Penetrating into the body is the key. It is an illusion but it is not. There are too many words said now and you don't understand.
